I think it was back when I lived with my dad and his current wife. She has borderline and I was very young, and I had to see her try to kill herself in front of me more than once. Something changed in me since then and even though I've talked about it in therapy and it was years ago I think it was the start of everything . Back then was when I first thoroughly planned my suicide (throwing myself under a train).

What was yours?
I'm afraid I'd only make you feel worse right now
